shipment_performance.description: One row per shipment with delay metrics — the first stop for any delivery, carrier, or lateness question.

columns.delay_days: Days late (positive) or early (negative) vs the promised date; NULL while in transit
columns.is_late: TRUE when delivered after the promised date
columns.order_value: Order value at risk in this shipment (quantity × unit price)
columns.dispatched: Date the shipment left the supplier
columns.delivered: Actual delivery date; NULL while in transit

stock_risk.description: Stock level vs reorder point per SKU and warehouse — the first stop for stockout and replenishment questions.

columns.below_reorder: TRUE when on-hand stock is below the reorder point
columns.days_of_cover: On-hand stock divided by average daily demand; NULL when no demand history
columns.reorder_point: Replenishment is triggered below this level

warehouse_utilization.description: Units stored vs capacity per warehouse — the first stop for capacity and utilization questions.

columns.utilization_pct: Units stored as a percentage of capacity (0-100)

columns.reliability_score: 0-100 composite of on-time rate, defect rate, responsiveness

inventory.description: Current on-hand stock per product and warehouse.

shipments.description: Inbound shipments fulfilling purchase orders. Prefer the shipment_performance mart for delay analysis.

demand_history.description: Weekly outbound demand per product and warehouse (Mondays).
